evidence: Modifies CMakeLists.txt to enable compiler warning flags `-Wmissing-prototypes` and `-Wmissing-declarations`.
rationale: Enables `-Wmissing-prototypes` and `-Wmissing-declarations` compiler warnings in CMake and resolves warning sites codebase-wide. While enforcing internal linkage and prototype inclusion prevents symbol clutter and declaration divergence, this is an internal build hygiene improvement without direct user impact or release-critical urgency.
